title: /copy without create: calendars/tasks/contacts accept it, mail returns invalidArguments
description: ibyi sweep: Calendars, Tasks and Contacts /copy silently accept a missing 'create' argument; Email/copy returns invalidArguments. RFC 8620 §5.4 lists create as required. Align on mail-server's behaviour (canonical template) with tests.
close_reason: CalendarEvent/Task/ContactCard/FileNode copy answer missing/non-object create with invalidArguments, as Email/copy
